name: RHB Bank Berhad
oneLine: Malaysia's fourth-largest banking group, serving individuals, businesses and corporates, with operations in Singapore and ASEAN.
inPlainWords: RHB takes deposits and lends to households, small businesses and large companies, mostly in Malaysia.
About 84% of its loans are in Malaysia; Singapore is its biggest overseas market.
Its Islamic arm, RHB Islamic, and its investment bank add Shariah financing and capital-market fees.
Its strategy plan to 2027 is called PROGRESS27.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Community Banking
segments.desc: Home, car and personal loans, deposits and wealth for individuals

segments.name: Corporate and Business Banking
segments.desc: Loans and cash management for SMEs and mid-sized companies

segments.name: Wholesale Banking
segments.desc: Large-company lending, treasury and investment banking

segments.name: International Business
segments.desc: Banking in Singapore and other ASEAN countries

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q2 FY2026 report p.46). Group support centre and others (a net cost of RM278.6m in 1H2026) is left out of the split.
